details.flavorMarkdown: *A strong, long-legged orc scout with weathered travel gear and a well-kept blade. This profile represents an outrider on foot, accustomed to protecting a moving caravan or border patrol.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A watch camp has been cleared without disturbing the surrounding brush.

**Purpose:** Keep strangers away from the caravan or homeland under their protection.

**Tactics and retreat:** Push a pursuer from a choke point, then move back to support the patrol.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Identify the real threat to the patrol’s charges or agree to a supervised passage.

**Habitat:** Steppe; border road · **Communication:** Common and Orc

**Loot:** Melee weapon, travel food d6 and 7 coins; no mount included in this profile.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-orc-outrider


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Mobile fighter · **CV:** 12

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clearing stroke | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. Push 1. | 6 physical damage. Push 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.15

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=5.000, O=3.653. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
